title: Does anyone else go to Halloween Town?
content: For the past 10 years, I've been dreaming I go to Halloween Town during the months of September and October til Halloween. Lately I've been going there every night. The dreams are so vivid and the feeling is very nostalgic and I feel happy when I go there. Usually I'm driving there and I'm rushing because I'm running late and everyone is already there and had started trick or treating. Sometimes I'll even dream I'm at a costume store trying to find a costume for Halloween Town. The Town has carnival rides that are shady looking and creepy old houses all around. Decorations and Halloween lights everywhere. People having a blast running around. I never want to leave since it's so much fun. If you leave the carnival, the Town is hilly and gloomy with creepy old houses. Anyone else?
